subject: Renewal paperwork — staged capacity ladder & indemnity carveout proposal
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@helixai.com>
Cc: legal@helixai.com, ops@helixai.com
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal paperwork — staged capacity ladder & indemnity carveout proposal

Hi Sana —

Thanks again for the renewal touchpoint yesterday. As discussed, HelixAI is planning a phased capacity expansion across Q3–Q4, and we want to get paperwork in place so engineering and billing can align to the ramp. A couple of asks from our side to keep the timeline intact: 

1) Attached is an updated Order Form (v3) that uses a staged capacity ladder: 0–200k tokens (Jun–Aug), 200k–500k (Sep–Nov), and 500k+ (Dec onward). Can you confirm these bands reflect your expected utilization pattern?

2) Your legal team proposed an indemnity carveout for third-party model licensing exposure. Redlines are helpful — we attached a marked-up MSA with our counter-suggestions (file: MSA_redline_helix.markup.docx). High level: we can accept a limited carveout but need a reciprocal remedy clause and a cap tied to the order value.

3) Timeline: Redwood is proposing DocuSign routing next Fri (6/21) so engineering can provision burst capacity the following week. If legal needs more time, please flag which clauses require escalation.

Attachments: Helix_OrderForm_v3.pdf (pdf), MSA_redline_helix.markup.docx (docx), capacity-ladder-proposal.xlsx (xlsx)

Appreciate a short confirmation (thumbs up / items to escalate) by Monday so we can stay on the provisioning path.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform
From: HelixAI Legal <legal@helixai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@helixai.com>, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — staged capacity ladder & indemnity carveout proposal

Hi Grace —

Thanks for sharing the order form and suggested MSA language. We circulated the redline to the team. High-level comments below and details in the attached marked-up MSA: MSA_redline_helix.markup.docx.

- Capacity ladder: the bands look fine, but Ops asks that the first band include an explicit burst allowance (we suggested +20% for the first 30 days). Please confirm Redwood can honor that burst without immediate reprovisioning.
- Indemnity carveout: Helix needs the carveout for third-party model licensing claims tied to models we bring into the inference pipeline. We can accept a reciprocal remedy clause, but cannot agree to a cap equal to total order value — that exposes us to outsized third-party liability. We proposed a $500k per-claim cap with an annual aggregate of $1M (see redline).
- Data residency clause: internal legal flagged the need to keep logs for 90 days for audit purposes. Can Redwood confirm retention and export procedure?

We attached a short summary page with the clauses that require negotiation. If your side can accept the burst allowance and the $500k/1M cap structure, we can proceed to DocuSign. Otherwise, we will need legal time (potentially a short call).

Regards,
HelixAI Legal
legal@helixai.com

Attachments: MSA_redline_helix.markup.docx (docx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: HelixAI Legal <legal@helixai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — staged capacity ladder & indemnity carveout proposal

Sana / Helix team —

Thanks for the quick read. Two practical proposals from our side to close this without a protracted legal loop: 

1) Burst allowance: Redwood will commit to a one-time 20% burst for the initial 30 days after signature, no extra lead time required. We'll log usage and trigger a provisioning notification at 75% of band capacity.

2) Indemnity cap compromise: Redwood cannot accept open-ended exposure. Counterproposal: per-claim cap of $750k with an annual aggregate of $1.5M; in return, Redwood will add an explicit remediation SLA (timebound patching and a remediation credit up to 3x affected month billing) for third-party model issues.

If Helix legal can accept the 750k/1.5M structure, Grace — please prepare a redline reflecting the remediation SLA and the burst allowance. Marissa, can you confirm billing/credit mechanics?

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0134
From: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@helixai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HelixAI Legal <legal@helixai.com>, ops@helixai.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — staged capacity ladder & indemnity carveout proposal

Ben —

Appreciate the pragmatic counter. Helix can take the 750k per-claim / 1.5M aggregate cap provided Redwood formalizes the remediation SLA (time to patch + credit mechanics) and confirms the one-time 20% burst for the initial 30 days. Ops still wants the 75% provisioning alert.

We will accept that structure and ask legal to incorporate the exact remediation language. If you can get a redline by EOD, we can route for internal approvals and get DocuSign ready.

Thanks,
Sana
Sana Reddy
Director, Cloud Ops | HelixAI
sana.reddy@helixai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sana Reddy <sana.reddy@helixai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, HelixAI Legal <legal@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork — staged capacity ladder & indemnity carveout proposal

Folks —

Attached is the agreed redline: we incorporated the one-time 20% burst, an alert at 75% utilization, and the remediation SLA with the credit mechanics (credit = 2x affected month usage, applied to next invoice). We landed on the per-claim cap of $750k and annual aggregate $1.5M as discussed. The final Order Form (Helix_OrderForm_v3.pdf) has the staged bands and billing schedule.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-Helix-Renewal

If legal at Helix confirms the redline language we can route for signature today and ops can start provisioning by next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
